title: Radio Nacional launches live broadcast of Cruzeiro vs Flamengo this Wednesday
seoTitle: Radio Nacional airs live Cruzeiro vs Flamengo Wed
subtitle: The station will broadcast, starting at 9:15 p.m., the knockout stage match of the 2026 Libertadores at Mineirão
excerpt: On Wednesday (12), Radio Nacional begins its live coverage of the 2026 Copa Libertadores knockout stage, featuring the Cruzeiro‑Flamengo clash at Mineirão.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Radio Nacional begins this Wednesday (12) with the live broadcast of the knockout stage of the 2026 Copa CONMEBOL Libertadores. The station will go on air at 9:15 p.m. with the clash between Cruzeiro and Flamengo, live from the Mineirão Stadium in Belo Horizonte (MG).

A decisive moment in the continental competition

The Copa Libertadores brings together clubs from various South American countries vying for the continental title. The knockout stage determines which teams advance to the final rounds, making every match decisive for staying in the competition.

The duel between Cruzeiro and Flamengo pits two Brazilian sides against each other, intensifying the rivalry within the tournament. Both teams will chase qualification, while the live broadcast lets fans follow every play in real time.

Mineirão as the match venue

The Mineirão Stadium, located in Belo Horizonte, will host the match. The venue is known for staging high‑profile games, providing suitable facilities for top‑level sporting events.

With the broadcast kicking off at 9:15 p.m., Radio Nacional listeners will be able to follow the match’s progress, the strategies employed by each side, and the decisive moments that will determine the winner.

With information from Agência Brasil.
